verdict.rationale: Docs describe a full admin surface for virtual keys, personal/team budgets, spend tracking, and rate limits (e.g. key.generate-style JSON with team_alias, rpm_limit, budget_duration) implying programmatic provisioning, but no OpenAPI/spec was found via probes and a community report explicitly cites 'issues with creating tokens for other users' plus general reliability complaints, undercutting confidence in smooth admin-API use.
